facts.fact: CERT.tg is described as Togo's national centre for responding to cybersecurity incidents, with a mission of detection, prevention and response.
CERT.tg issued a public alert on a surge of compromises of WhatsApp, Facebook and other online accounts in Togo; the article dates it to Thursday 20 August 2026 (inferred from its publication date).

systems.system: CERT.tg (Centre national de reponse aux incidents de cybersecurite)
